segmente.text: You can make people buy without saying a word to them.
The method is called priming, and it is the reason why brands exist.
Tiny hints in what people see, hear, or feel can shift their mood and decisions without them ever realizing it.
For example, show a scene of comfort before selling furniture.
Show happy families before promoting vacations.
These little mental seeds make your offer feel right before you even place it.
They plant this association in your customer's brain, and when the mind is already in the right frame, the sale feels like their own idea.
